Pass a decree in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants declaring that notice dated 2-3-2008 issued under the signature of defendant No. 6 treating the plaintiff as an "unauthorized occupant" directing him to vacate a piece of land measuring 2.083 kathas of the suit land is illegal, null and void and not binding upon the plaintiff.

Pass a decree in favour of the plaintiff and against the Government-defendants directing them to rectify the indenture of lease made on 17th June 1981 being deed No. 3192 of Book No. 1, Volume No. 56, P-292-301 in respect of Plot No. 61, Road No. 4, Block-B, section 12, Mirpur Housing Estate, PS formally Mirpur now Pallabi, Dhaka fully described in the schedule, by executing a deed of rectification with regard to the measurement of the land inserting therein the figures "730.20sq yards" in place of the figures "533.33 sq yards" wherever it occurs in the said deed on payment of a sum of Taka 26,572.25 to the Government-defendant or the amount which the Court may assess as the valuation of the land measuring 196.87 sq. yards (730.20 minus 533.33) under the law and equity.
